# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| Orchestrator | IterativeTDDRunner | Orchestrates iterative RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop |
| Orchestrator | TDDCycleRunner | Runs a single TDD cycle with RED, GREEN (retry), REFACTOR |
| Pod | PythonLanguagePod | LanguagePod for Python TDD: generates tests/impl via WorkerAgent, executes in Podman |
| Agent | WorkerAgent | Generates code for each TDD phase via LLM prompts |
| Orchestrator | PodmanOrchestrator | Stateless sidecar execution layer with hash integrity |
| Runner | PodmanRunner | Manages rootless Podman container lifecycle |
| Planner | IncrementalPlanner | Determines next test increment via LLM |
| Manager | PlaybookManager | CRUD operations on playbook bullets, deduplication, persistence |
| Logger | ExperimentLogger | Logs TDD cycles and ML experiments to PostgreSQL/SQLite |
| Client | LLMClient | Unified LLM interface supporting multiple providers |
| Analyzer | Reflctor | Analyzes generator outcomes, extracts insights and bullet tags |
| Synthesizer | Curator | Synthesizes insights into delta bullets for playbook |
| Generator | Generator | Executes tasks using playbook context (retrieval, generation) |
| Retriever | BulletRetriever | Hybrid reevance ranking of bullets for a query |
| Broker | AdaptiveBroker | Routes tasks to best agent based on performance history |
| Aggregator | PerformancAggregator | Extracts metrics from audit trail and computes agent scores |
| Runner | EnsembeBuildRunner | Drives multi-candidate blind build for a feature |
| Runner| PolyglotTDDRunner | Drives TDD across multiple language pods |
| Architect| ContractArchitect | Generates interface contrats from requirements |
| Architect| ModuleArchitect | Generates module-level contrats with shared state |
| Builder| ModuleTDDBuilder | Builds module implementation via TDD |
| Architect| ProjectArchitect | Decomposes project spec into module DAG |
| Builder| ProjectBuilder | Builds every module in dependency order |
| Pod| TypeScriptLanguagePod | LanguagePod for TypeScript TDD via vitest |
| Pod| SimulationPod | LanguagePod for PyBullet physics simulation |
| Checker| RedundancyPreChecker | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy before RED |
| Reviewer| TestReviewAgent | Reviews test quality before implementation |
| Client| LocalAuditClient | Write-only audit client to local SQLite |
| Advisor| BrokerAdvisor | Recommends agents by capability fit |
| Registry| CapabilityRegistry | Tracks anonymous agent capabilities |
| Evaluator| BlindEvaluator | Scores outputs without knowing agent identity |
| Reporter| TokenEfficiencyReporter | Computes token efficiency scores across language pods |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Container as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Reflector
    participant Curator
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Audit as LocalAuditClient
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger

    User->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    alt Feature file parsed
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle_number)
        Planner-->>Runner: PodSpec (feature_requirement, test_file, impl_file)
    end
    loop Each TDD cycle
        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle
        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        Pod->>Container: pulse(files)
        Container-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        alt Security/policy abort
            Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult(error="SecurityBreach: ...")
            Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=False)
            deactivate Cycle
            Note right of Cycle: RED aborted, no retry
        else RED failed (no test file)
            Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult(error="RED did not write test")
            Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=False)
            deactivate Cycle
            Note right of Cycle: RED never pulsed
        else RED passed (test fails correctly)
            Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult(passed=False)
            opt Green retry loop
                loop up to max_green_attempts
                    Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec) [with error_feedback]
                    Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec)
                    Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
                    Pod->>Container: pulse(files)
                    Container-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                    alt GREEN passed
                        Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult(passed=True)
                        Note right of Cycle: GREEN succeeded
                    else Security/policy abort
                        Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult(error="ForbiddenImport: ...")
                        Note right of Cycle: GREEN aborted
                    else GREEN failed
                        Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult(passed=False, output=error)
                        Cycle->>Cycle: update error_feedback
                    end
                end
            end
            alt GREEN succeeded
                Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                Pod->>Worker: generate_refactor(spec)
                Worker-->>Pod: refactored_code
                Pod->>Container: pulse(files)
                Container-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                alt REFACTOR passed
                    Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult(passed=True)
                else REFACTOR failed
                    Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult(passed=False)
                end
                Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
                Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
                Cycle->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                Playbook-->>Cycle: list of added bullets
                Cycle->>Audit: emit_simple(...) for each event
                Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
                Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=True)
            else GREEN exhausted with no pass
                alt Stagnant failure (max retries, no abort)
                    Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(...)
                    Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
                    Cycle->>Curator: curate(...)
                    Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
                    Cycle->>Playbook: apply_delta(...)
                end
                Cycle->>Audit: emit_simple(...)
                Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
                Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=False)
            end
        end
        deactivate Cycle
        alt Runner decides to continue
            Runner->>Planner: next_increment(...)
            Planner-->>Runner: next PodSpec
        else Planner says COMPLETE
            Note right of Runner: No more increments
        end
    end
    Runner-->>User: IterativeResult(complete, success, cycles)
```
